images.caption: photograph of the view due north of the street nearby the Church of Jesus Christ (Cutlerite), showing the church's relative proximity to the Community of Christ Independence Temple (shown), and therefore to the historic "Temple Lot" site. I believe this is important to illustrate due to Alpheus Cutler and his follower's close connection to "Mormon Temple"-building.
